description: This PHP test class performs unit testing of the CandidateAllowedActionAPI within the OrangeHRM recruitment module. It includes test cases for retrieving all candidate allowed actions and checks that certain methods throw not implemented exceptions.

classes.name: CandidateAllowedActionAPITest
classes.description: Unit test class for the CandidateAllowedActionAPI, testing retrieval of candidate allowed actions and verifying method behaviors for not implemented features.

methods.name: setUpBeforeClass
methods.description: Sets up test data before any tests run by loading fixture definitions.

methods.name: testGetAll
methods.description: Tests the retrieval of all candidate allowed actions via the API endpoint.

methods.name: dataProviderForTestGetAll
methods.description: Provides test cases data for the testGetAll method.

methods.name: testCreate
methods.description: Validates that the create method of the API throws a not implemented exception.

methods.name: testGetValidationRuleForCreate
methods.description: Checks that the validation rule for create is not implemented.

methods.name: testDelete
methods.description: Verifies that delete method of the API throws a not implemented exception.

methods.name: testGetValidationRuleForDelete
methods.description: Checks that the validation rule for delete is not implemented.
